notes: VCA303 refinements (Buyer Due List carry-over): the diagonal 'Carry Over' stamp is now 75% bigger (21pt), slanted 35° (was 45°), coloured to match the card header name (per gender/dormant), starts from the row above 'தொடர்கிறது →', and is moved right so its first letter isn't clipped. Packing: LONG buyers now print first, then smaller cards auto-fit into the leftover space (incl. a long buyer's part-full last column) so the page is better utilised.
